jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager, Japan
jobs.description:
About Glean:

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About the Role:

Glean is seeking a Content Marketing Manager, Japan to build our Japanese content marketing engine. Reporting to the Head of Japan Field Marketing, you will create and localize credible content for Japanese enterprise buyers, then work with Sales, partners, and marketing teams to ensure it reaches the right audiences and contributes to demand and pipeline.

This is an individual contributor role. “Manager” reflects ownership of the content marketing function and does not currently include people-management responsibilities.

You will:

- Own Japan’s content priorities and editorial calendar based on local buyer needs and business goals.

- Improve priority Japanese website pages and lead localization and editorial quality for global content.

- Create Japan-native content such as customer stories, blog articles, solution guides, white papers, e-books, and video scripts.

- Build practical SEO and AIO/GEO programs that improve discovery, engagement, and conversion.

- Develop Japanese customer references and proof points with customers, Sales, Customer Success, Communications, and Legal.

- Partner with Sales and Field Marketing to identify content gaps in priority accounts and active opportunities, and develop sales-ready assets that help buyers take the next step.

- Plan how major content will be distributed and activated across digital, events, partners, nurture, and Sales channels.

- Collaborate with Glean partners to review deliverables and co-create content that is relevant to shared customers and campaigns.

- Manage agencies and freelancers while maintaining ownership of messaging, product accuracy, and final quality.

- Measure content performance and use the results to improve engagement, lead generation, Sales usage, and pipeline influence.

About you:

- You are a native-level Japanese writer and editor with professional English communication skills.

- You have 7+ years of B2B content marketing experience, ideally in enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud, data, cybersecurity, or AI.

- You have owned content beyond production, including distribution, activation, and performance measurement.

- You understand Japanese enterprise buyers and can explain complex technology in clear, credible business language.

- You have experience with website content, SEO, analytics, customer stories, and demand-generation assets.

- You can work hands-on while managing multiple projects, agencies, and stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.

- You are an effective cross-functional partner who can work with local, regional, global, and external partner teams.

- You use AI tools thoughtfully to improve research, creation, repurposing, and analysis while maintaining strong editorial standards.

Location:

- This role is remote and must be based in Tokyo, Japan.

Compensation & Benefits:

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

#LI-REMOTE

AI-First Mindset at Glean:

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy . By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement .

By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement , and I agree to the terms.

About the Role:

Glean is seeking a Partner Sales Manager to build and manage strategic partners to expand Glean’s customer reach in Europe. This individual will be closely aligned to multiple sales segment teams and be responsible for building and executing the partner strategy to drive meaningful revenue impact—in a hands-on, results-oriented role.

You will:

- Build and maintain executive and working-level relationships across key partnerships and the Glean sales teams that translate into measurable sourced and influenced pipeline growth

- Educate and coach the Glean Sales teams on the “why” and the “how” of scaling with our revenue growth with partners

- Define and operationalize co-selling and co-delivery motions that are aligned with Glean’s field priorities and designed to scale with the right partners.

- Build repeatable plays for sourcing new opportunities, including campaigns, events, account mapping, and outbound motions, and maintain clear visibility into partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.

- Work cross-functionally with Sales, SE, Marketing, Operations, and Legal to simplify and scale partner processes such as deal registration, approvals, contracts, MDF and reporting.

- Embed with the sales organization by aligning partners to territories, participating in key deal reviews and account planning, and ensuring partners feel like an extension of the Glean field teams.

About you:

- Outcome- and revenue-oriented partner leader who thinks like a GM/business owner, not just a relationship manager, and is comfortable being accountable for partner-driven pipeline and bookings.

- 8+ years experience in channel, alliances, partner management, or business development roles in B2B SaaS.

- German language proficiency strongly preferred, to support partnerships and account coverage across DACH markets.

- Background in search, AI, productivity, or enterprise SaaS is required. With at least 1-2 years of experience in frontier AI sales, having worked on and delivered projects — either directly with customers or via partners — implementing AI solutions.

- Demonstrated success recruiting, activating, and growing SI/VAR or similar partners, not just managing inherited relationships.

- Strong collaborator with sales, with experience working in tight lockstep with regional leaders and field reps to align partners to territories, accounts, and plays.

- Excellent communicator and influencer, comfortable presenting to executives, negotiating with partner leaders, and coaching partner sellers and SEs.

- Familiarity with modern sales and partner tooling, including CRM, PRM, and reporting/BI tools, and comfort navigating evolving tech stacks.

- Able to travel periodically to partners, key accounts, and internal events, including SKOs and GKOs, as needed.

- Experience operating across multiple European markets, comfortable navigating different languages, business cultures, and regulatory environments to expand partner coverage.

Location:

- This role is hybrid (Minimum 1 day per week)

About the Role:

Glean is seeking a Private Equity Partnerships Manager to build and scale our ecosystem with leading private equity and investment firms. In this role, you will own relationships with top sponsors and drive adoption of Glean across their portfolios, sitting at the intersection of PE, AI, and enterprise transformation.

You’ll structure and manage portfolio‑wide commercial frameworks, oversee deployment motions across PortCos, and ensure Glean delivers measurable EBITDA and enterprise value impact for PE‑backed businesses. This is a manager‑level, quota‑carrying role within Partnerships, working closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success.

You are fluent in PE economics, comfortable navigating multi‑stakeholder environments across funds and PortCos, and able to manage AI value‑creation plays from term sheet through exit. Success is measured by converting PE partnerships into live deployments, pipeline, and revenue across your sponsors.

You will:

- Drive PE partnership strategy & deal management

- Structure, negotiate, and execute PE partnership agreements (preferred pricing, portfolio‑wide frameworks, lighthouse PortCo plays).

- Draft reusable cross‑portfolio pricing and partnership agreements with Legal, Finance, and RevOps.

- Coordinate internal approvals and external sign‑off with GP leadership, operating partners, and PortCo executives.

- Maintain standardized pricing and commercial constructs so AEs have clear guidance on using PE frameworks in deals.

- Sponsor relationship management

- Serve as Glean’s primary day‑to‑day contact for multiple PE sponsors.

- Build deep relationships with operating partners, portfolio ops, deal teams, and technology/data leaders.

- Run recurring cadences (QBRs, portfolio and pipeline reviews, exec check‑ins) to surface and advance opportunities.

- Maintain current views of key contacts, portfolios, and in‑flight initiatives per sponsor.

- Portfolio activation & deployment oversight

- Drive PortCo activation by identifying high‑value AI use cases (e.g., GTM, finance, engineering, support/back‑office).

- Support scoping and oversee evaluation, pilot, and rollout cycles with AEs, AI Outcomes/CS, Solutions, and SIs.

- Coordinate with Product, Engineering, and partners to meet quality, security, and timeline expectations.

- Track and communicate deployment metrics (adoption, usage, revenue/cost/EBITDA impact) to sponsors and management teams.

- Revenue, pipeline & program performance

- Own pipeline development and revenue targets for assigned sponsors.

- Maintain a rolling forecast of opportunities across portfolios (sourced and influenced).

- Work with AEs to map portfolios, track activity, and prioritize accounts by sponsor focus, AI readiness, and value potential.

- Ensure clean partner/opportunity data in CRM and build dashboards for PE‑sourced/influenced pipeline, ARR, coverage, and velocity.

- Surface insights and recommendations to improve motions, offers, and enablement.

- Enablement & cross‑functional coordination

- Build and update concise enablement assets (one‑pagers, decks, FAQs, playbooks) for sponsors and PortCos.

- Develop case studies and portfolio‑level proof points; run enablement sessions and workshops to drive adoption.

- Design and execute programmatic engagement (fireside chats, webinars, roundtables, dinners) with PE and PortCo execs.

- Partner with Sales and Enablement on portfolio‑wide sessions and briefings.

- Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal, Security, RevOps, and Customer Success to move deals forward and feed learnings into the roadmap.

- Coordinate with SI / implementation partners on joint delivery, ensuring aligned messaging and execution.

About you:

- Experience

- 5–10+ years in enterprise SaaS and/or fintech across partnerships, BD, sales, PE‑backed operating roles, or management consulting serving PE clients.

- Direct experience with technology partnerships with PE sponsors or multi‑entity / portfolio structures strongly preferred.

- Proven track record working with sales to drive pipeline and revenue (co‑sell, partner‑sourced deals, complex accounts).

- Strong program/project management skills: multiple concurrent workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines with high attention to detail.

- Able to operate as both strategist and executor across cross‑portfolio deployments.

-  PE & commercial acumen

- Strong familiarity with fund structures, GP/carry economics, value‑creation playbooks, and sponsor–PortCo dynamics.

- Comfortable with commercial discussions (pricing, discounts, basic economics) and iterating on term sheets within guardrails.

- AI & technical fluency

- Fluent in AI and agentic AI concepts; can credibly discuss Glean with technical teams and PE investors.

- Able to translate AI capabilities into portfolio‑level value creation narratives (EBITDA, efficiency, growth, multiple expansion).

- Communication & collaboration

- Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable with C‑suite‑level decks and crisp internal updates.

- Proven ability to build trust and alignment across internal and external stakeholders in fast‑moving environments.

- Mindset

- Scrappy, curious, and excited to help define and scale Glean’s PE partnership motion.

- Thrive in ambiguity and shifting priorities.

- Passionate about AI’s potential to transform the economy and aligned with Glean’s mission to deliver safe, enterprise‑grade AI with real business impact.

Location:

- This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our New York City office)

Compensation & Benefits:

The standard OTE (on‑target earnings) range for this position is $250,000 – $300,000 annually, with competitive equity and benefits. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.

We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. About the Role:

Glean is looking for a Senior Field Marketing Manager, Strategic Accounts (West US)  to own the field marketing strategy and executive programs for the Strategic-West sales segment, partnering closely with RVPs and account teams to drive engagement and pipeline progression across a defined set of named accounts. You will design and execute executive‑level experiences that deepen relationships with C-Level executives and business leaders, and you’ll ensure each program is tightly mapped to our strategic account plans and revenue goals.

This role is focused on high-impact, white-glove programs that engage the most senior stakeholders in our top accounts.

You will partner closely with:

- Our Strategic Sales segment in West (RVPs and account teams)

- Our ABM team, to ensure programs align to named account strategies and multi‑touch plays

- Our Brand team, to ensure every experience feels premium, on‑brand, and differentiated

You are an experienced field or ABM marketer who has built C‑level, white‑glove programs before – executive dinners, boardroom sessions, innovation forums, and bespoke experiences tailored to a small number of high‑value accounts. You thrive in executive‑facing environments, are credible with senior stakeholders, and love turning a strategic account objective into a memorable experience with clear pipeline impact.

You will:

- Partner directly with Strategic AEs and RVPs on account planning to identify key deal moments, executive relationships, and opportunities where field programs can accelerate pipeline.

- Design and deliver white‑glove, C‑level experiences

- Partner cross‑functionally with ABM and Brand teams

- Establish a measurement framework for executive programs focused on:

- Stage 2+ pipeline creation and acceleration within named accounts

- Meetings with VP+ buyers generated through programs

- Sales-validated impact on top opportunities

- Champion a “less is more” philosophy — prioritizing fewer, higher-impact executive experiences that directly support priority deals and strategic accounts.

About you:

- 7+ years of experience in B2B SaaS in field marketing, ABM, or executive programs, with a meaningful portion focused on C‑level or VP+ audiences.

- Experience partnering with Strategic Sales teams to influence or accelerate deals >$500K ACV.

- Proven track record of designing and executing white‑glove, executive‑level programs for a small number of strategic or global accounts (not volume‑based events).

- Comfortable and credible in executive‑facing environments; you know how to support leaders in the room and how to design experiences that resonate with CIOs, CISOs, and line‑of‑business executives.

- Demonstrated success partnering closely with Strategic or Enterprise Sales teams, including RVPs/RDs and multi‑threaded account teams.

- Clear examples of driving to pipeline and ARR outcomes in named accounts (deal acceleration, stage progression, multi‑threading, and win rate improvement), not just registrations or attendance.

- Strong cross‑functional collaborator with experience working with ABM, Brand, Product Marketing, and Customer Marketing.

- Exceptionally organized and detail‑oriented, able to manage multiple high‑stakes programs, senior stakeholders, and vendors without dropping the ball.

- Comfortable operating in high‑growth, fast‑paced environments with evolving priorities; you can be both strategic and hands‑on.

- Experience with tools like Salesforce, Marketo, ABM platforms (e.g., 6sense / Demandbase), Splash/Cvent, and project management tools is a plus.

Location:

- This role is hybrid in our San Francisco or Mountain View office or Remote in a West US state

- Expect up to 40% travel

The standard base salary range for this position is $163,000 - $187,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

About Glean:

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About the Role:

Glean is seeking a strategic, data-driven, and execution-oriented VP of Growth Marketing to lead our global growth engine across Demand Generation, Digital, Field Marketing, and Partner Marketing—and to shape the future of demand generation for an AI-native company navigating an ever-evolving market. You will own how Marketing turns spend, programs, and team execution into measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes for Glean’s Enterprise AI platform, partnering closely with Sales, SDRs, Product Marketing, Corp Marketing, Customer Marketing, RevOps, and Executive leadership to set growth priorities, allocate investment, improve conversion, and scale what works.

This is a highly visible leadership role for a leader who can operate strategically while remaining close to execution—setting the annual growth plan, designing the operating model for pipeline creation and conversion, rigorously evaluating performance, coaching a high-performing team, and stepping in directly when a launch, funnel challenge, or major growth initiative requires hands-on leadership.

You will sit at the center of Glean’s go-to-market motion, helping establish Glean as the category-defining AI platform by building a predictable, AI-first demand engine that fuels new-logo growth and expansion across our customer base.

You will:

- Own Glean's growth marketing strategy and execution, leading demand generation, digital, ABM, field marketing, partner marketing, and integrated campaigns with accountability for pipeline, revenue, and ARR growth.

- Serve as a core member of the executive go-to-market leadership team, partnering closely with Sales, SDR, Product, Partnerships, Customer Success, Finance, and RevOps to shape GTM strategy and accelerate company growth.

- Build and scale a world-class growth engine that consistently delivers predictable, efficient pipeline across Enterprise, Commercial, and Global markets.

- Translate company growth objectives into marketing strategy, investment priorities, operating plans, and measurable business outcomes across segments, regions, and channels.

- Lead, coach, and inspire a high-performing team across demand generation, digital marketing, ABM, field marketing, partner marketing, and campaign strategy, fostering a culture of ownership, experimentation, and operational excellence.

- Architect integrated go-to-market programs that connect product launches, thought leadership, digital, events, field marketing, partner ecosystems, and ABM into a scalable growth engine.

- Champion an AI-first marketing organization by embedding AI into campaign planning, content creation, experimentation, personalization, reporting, and operational workflows—making Glean the showcase for modern AI-powered marketing.

- Build the operating cadence that aligns executive leadership around pipeline health, forecast accuracy, investment decisions, campaign performance, and continuous optimization.

About you:

- 12+ years of B2B SaaS or enterprise technology marketing experience, with leadership responsibility for growth, demand generation, or revenue marketing supporting enterprise sales.

- Proven track record of building and scaling growth engines that deliver predictable pipeline, revenue, and ROI through integrated digital, ABM, field, partner, and lifecycle marketing.

- Strong business and analytical acumen, with expertise in forecasting, attribution, funnel optimization, investment planning, and marketing performance measurement.

- Experienced people leader who has built and developed high-performing teams and leaders, creating a culture of accountability, experimentation, and operational excellence.

- Executive-level communicator with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, translate data into strategic decisions, and align teams around shared business goals.

- Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments, bringing structure to ambiguity while balancing speed, rigor, and continuous experimentation.

- AI-first mindset, with hands-on experience leveraging AI to improve marketing execution, personalization, analytics, and team productivity.

- This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View office)
